Name: Ethiopian Organic by Balanoor Plantation
Desc: Location – Chikmagalur, Karnataka Altitude – 1465 Masl Varietal – Ethiopian Organic Process – Washed Cup Notes – Rose Petal Jam ( गुलकंद ), Dried Apricot, Spiced Walnuts Roast Profile – Light Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz A rare Ethiopian heirloom varietal, introduced to India through the Coffee Board’s trial program, this coffee has found a home in its own dedicated certified organic block at 4,800 ft. Over two decades old, these plants produce a cup that is both distinctive and beautifully balanced. Expect bright citrus layered with caramelised roasted nuts, carried by a lively citric and malic acidity. Aromatics of brown spice, floral, and molasses lead to a rounded mouthfeel, finishing with lingering notes of roasted nuts, sweet citrus, and spices . Grown with certified organic practices, this is a rare expression of an Ethiopian heirloom, nurtured in Indian soil while staying true to its vibrant character.

Name: Banana Kents by Balanoor Plantation
Desc: Location – Chikmagalur, Karnataka Altitude – 1200 Masl Varietal – Kents Process – PSD Cup Notes – Jaggery Bites, Plum, Cocoa Roast Profile – Medium Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz Merthi Subbangudigy Estate (MS Estate) is located in the Sahyadari ranges of the Western Ghats, Chikmagalur, Karnataka. The estate is part of Balanoor Plantations which is run by Mr Ashok Kuriyan and his son Mr Rohan Kuriyan. Arabicas (rain forest certified) are grown under the shade of tress like, Silver Oaks, Dadaps and various jungle woods. Special attention is paid to every aspect of picking, pulping, fermenting, washing, drying and curing. The practice of sustainability and environmental responsibility is the heart of the farm. About the Process- The Kents banana leaf psd is a special coffee for us as it's one of the first experiments we did last year which succeeded. The coffee is carefully harvested to ensure only the best cherry is taken for this nano lot. The cherries are pulped trying to retain as much mucilage on the bean before it is dried on the raised beds under fresh banana leaves. The coffee is raked frequently and the leaves changed when it dries. The pulp and the banana leaf give these coffees it's sweet cupping notes.

Masl Varietal – SLN 795 HG Process – Washed Cup Notes – Berries, Peach and Walnut Roast Profile – Medium, Medium-Dark (Espresso) Net wt. - 250 g | 8.8 oz Merthi Subbangudigy Estate (MS Estate) is located in the Sahyadari ranges of the Western Ghats, Chikmagalur, Karnataka. The estate is part of Balanoor Plantations which is run by Mr Ashok Kuriyan and his son Mr Rohan Kuriyan. Arabicas (rain forest certified) are grown under the shade of tress like, Silver Oaks, Dadaps and various jungle woods. Special attention is paid to every aspect of picking, pulping, fermenting, washing, drying and curing. The practice of sustainability and environmental responsibility is the heart of the farm.
